title: (RHBA-2022:1452) s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
An update for s390utils is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4
Extended Update Support.
portal_synopsis: s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems - Extended Update Support|8.4|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat CodeReady Linux Builder for IBM z Systems - Extended Update Support|8.4|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be
used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL8.4 - dasd: change default scheduler to reduce CPU consumption (s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1988391)

*  RHEL8.4 - dbginfo.sh: Collect /proc/kallsyms, issue additional commands (s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1988409)

* add support for NM keyfile format to ccw_init (BZ#2002391)

* move fdasd, lszdev and vmcp into s390utils-core package for 8.4
(BZ#2032507)
